instruction: Walk to the blue cube and stop next to it: finish standing still with the midpoint of your feet within 10 cm of the cube, without knocking the cube away.
robot: Pollen Microduck: a 25 cm, 800 g biped with 5-DoF legs and a 4-DoF head carrying the head camera, driven by a pretrained walking policy that takes velocity commands

twist.frame: trunk (robot) frame: +x forward, +y left, yaw counter-clockwise from above
twist.semantics: a velocity command to the pretrained walking policy; it is held for every step of the call. Below 0.05 in magnitude the standing policy runs instead.

head.unit: rad, delta from the home pose
head.semantics: head pose targets tracked by the policy; positive head_yaw turns the camera left, positive pitch tilts it down. The head camera moves with the head.

action_layout.step: one control step is 20 ms of physics; the policy runs once per step
